rows.prompt: Create one intuitive fantasy skill icon on a transparent background. Use a 64x64 logical pixel grid with crisp stepped edges and large solid color blocks. Use a compact palette of 8-12 solid colors at most; each material has only one base color and at most one shadow color. Center one dominant subject filling about 75 percent of the canvas, with at most one simple action or effect. Keep the silhouette readable at 32x32. No text, letters, numbers, frame, border, scenery, texture, thin lines, metallic reflections, shine, glow, gradients, particles, or dense detail. Deliberately simple and restrained.
